domain.name: Data Analysis & Spreadsheets
domain.description: Practical spreadsheet modeling, cleaning, analysis, visualization, metrics, forecasting, and experiments.

competencies.name: Spreadsheet Modeling
competencies.description: Build clear, auditable spreadsheet models for operational and business decisions.
competencies.purpose: Build clear, auditable spreadsheet models for operational and business decisions.

units.title: Spreadsheet Modeling: core principle
units.content: Separate assumptions, calculations, and outputs so inputs can change without hiding hard-coded logic.

units.title: Spreadsheet Modeling: working procedure
units.content: Define the decision; list inputs with units; build formulas in logical blocks; add checks; label outputs; test edge cases; document assumptions.

units.title: Spreadsheet Modeling: common failures
units.content: Avoid hidden constants in formulas, mixed units, circular references, unlabeled assumptions, and models with no error checks.

drills.title: Practice Spreadsheet Modeling
drills.prompt: Build a job-profitability model with price, direct costs, labor hours, fees, travel, contribution margin, and effective hourly return.

competencies.name: Data Cleaning & Normalization
competencies.description: Prepare messy operational data for reliable analysis.
competencies.purpose: Prepare messy operational data for reliable analysis.

units.title: Data Cleaning & Normalization: core principle
units.content: Cleaning should make data consistent without destroying the original evidence.

units.title: Data Cleaning & Normalization: working procedure
units.content: Profile columns; preserve a raw copy; normalize types, dates, text, categories, and IDs; identify duplicates; handle missing values explicitly; log material transformations.

units.title: Data Cleaning & Normalization: common failures
units.content: Avoid silently converting IDs, deleting unusual rows without review, replacing blanks with zero by default, or mixing raw and cleaned records.

drills.title: Practice Data Cleaning & Normalization
drills.prompt: Clean a client CSV with duplicate names, inconsistent phone/date formats, blanks, and trailing spaces.

competencies.name: Formulas, Lookups & Logic
competencies.description: Use spreadsheet formulas and lookups to connect and calculate data reliably.
competencies.purpose: Use spreadsheet formulas and lookups to connect and calculate data reliably.

units.title: Formulas, Lookups & Logic: core principle
units.content: Stable keys are more reliable than names or free text when joining records.

units.title: Formulas, Lookups & Logic: working procedure
units.content: Define expected input/output; use exact matching; isolate complex logic; handle missing matches visibly; lock references intentionally; test known and failure cases.

units.title: Formulas, Lookups & Logic: common failures
units.content: Avoid unintended approximate matches, shifted references, giant nested IF logic, and suppressing every error.

drills.title: Practice Formulas, Lookups & Logic
drills.prompt: Connect invoice rows to clients by stable ID and return owner, status, and terms while flagging unmatched records.

competencies.name: Pivot Tables & Aggregation
competencies.description: Summarize large datasets by meaningful dimensions and measures.
competencies.purpose: Summarize large datasets by meaningful dimensions and measures.

units.title: Pivot Tables & Aggregation: core principle
units.content: The aggregation method must match the question and the grain of the data.

units.title: Pivot Tables & Aggregation: working procedure
units.content: Define question and row grain; choose dimensions; add measures; filter intentionally; validate totals against source data; label units and time windows.

units.title: Pivot Tables & Aggregation: common failures
units.content: Avoid duplicate rows inflating totals, averaging averages, summing identifiers, or hiding filters that change interpretation.

drills.title: Practice Pivot Tables & Aggregation
drills.prompt: Design a pivot for revenue, job count, average ticket, and contribution by service type and month.

competencies.name: Data Visualization
competencies.description: Choose charts that make trends, comparisons, distributions, and relationships easy to understand.
competencies.purpose: Choose charts that make trends, comparisons, distributions, and relationships easy to understand.

units.title: Data Visualization: core principle
units.content: Chart form should match the question; visual decoration should never distort the evidence.

units.title: Data Visualization: working procedure
units.content: State the takeaway; choose the simplest fitting chart; label units; use honest scales; reduce clutter; annotate material events; verify the visual implication.

units.title: Data Visualization: common failures
units.content: Avoid truncated axes that exaggerate differences, unnecessary dual axes, decorative 3D, hidden denominators, and unreadable series counts.

drills.title: Practice Data Visualization
drills.prompt: Choose visuals for a 13-week cash forecast showing weekly balance, inflows, outflows, and a minimum-cash threshold.

competencies.name: KPI & Metric Design
competencies.description: Define metrics that connect activity to outcomes and decisions.
competencies.purpose: Define metrics that connect activity to outcomes and decisions.

units.title: KPI & Metric Design: core principle
units.content: A KPI needs a definition, data source, review cadence, owner, and decision it can influence.

units.title: KPI & Metric Design: working procedure
units.content: Define business question; formula and denominator; inclusion rules; time window; source; target/reference; owner; review cadence; gaming risks.

units.title: KPI & Metric Design: common failures
units.content: Avoid vanity metrics, changing definitions, percentages with tiny denominators, and targets that reward harmful shortcuts.

drills.title: Practice KPI & Metric Design
drills.prompt: Define a compact KPI set from content reach through qualified lead, booking, revenue, and margin.

competencies.name: Operational Forecasting
competencies.description: Build forecasts from history, known commitments, and explicit assumptions.
competencies.purpose: Build forecasts from history, known commitments, and explicit assumptions.

units.title: Operational Forecasting: core principle
units.content: A forecast is conditional, not a promise; distinguish booked/known demand from uncertain pipeline.

units.title: Operational Forecasting: working procedure
units.content: Choose horizon/grain; clean history; identify seasonality and structural changes; add known commitments; build downside/base/upside cases; track forecast error.

units.title: Operational Forecasting: common failures
units.content: Avoid extrapolating one unusual month, hiding assumption changes, or presenting a single precise estimate as certainty.

drills.title: Practice Operational Forecasting
drills.prompt: Forecast monthly bookings using booked work, qualified pipeline, historical conversion, seasonality, and scenarios.

competencies.name: Experiments & Practical Statistics
competencies.description: Use controlled comparisons and basic statistics to evaluate changes.
competencies.purpose: Use controlled comparisons and basic statistics to evaluate changes.

units.title: Experiments & Practical Statistics: core principle
units.content: Learning requires a credible comparison; correlation alone does not prove causation.

units.title: Experiments & Practical Statistics: working procedure
units.content: Define hypothesis and primary metric; establish baseline/control; isolate major variable; choose duration/sample rule; predefine stopping criteria; record result and uncertainty.

units.title: Experiments & Practical Statistics: common failures
units.content: Avoid tiny-sample winners, changing many variables at once, stopping when results first look good, or selecting only favorable metrics afterward.

drills.title: Practice Experiments & Practical Statistics
drills.prompt: Design a test comparing two landing-page hero messages for qualified-lead rate.
